question: Within the pre-existing causal BTC-uptrend eligibility state, does current antisymmetric ETH/SOL relative market state predict subsequent path-integrated Beta leadership better than static prevalence, lagged-leader persistence and simple 60-day relative momentum, and does calibrated confidence contain enough recurrent economic-margin information to justify a later concentration study?
hypothesis: ETH/SOL leadership is a dynamic relative-value process. Non-overlapping age-bucket relative momentum, persistence, symmetric relative position and relative quote-volume participation should provide incremental information beyond simple causal baselines. If that information is real, calibrated confidence should be positively associated with the subsequent direction-corrected ETH/SOL path margin; a reliable high-confidence breakpoint may or may not exist.
economic_mechanism: 0048 isolates selection inside the Beta tier. BTC is a defensive anchor, not a competing 0048 winner. In a causal BTC-trend-supportive environment, ETH and SOL may alternate as the stronger Beta path because relative momentum information has different ages, persistence and participation confirmation. 0048 tests only predictive leadership information and confidence-to-realized-margin structure; it does not test portfolio weights, Beta-to-BTC shelter timing, BTC-to-cash exit, CAGR, drawdown or production rules.
stopping_rule: After this preregistration and dataset declaration are merged, implement exactly one frozen 0048 candidate on a separate implementation-only branch with no result files. After the implementation boundary is green, execute exactly one valid historical DEVELOPMENT evaluation. Any candidate model, target, feature, eligibility, training, calibration, baseline, bootstrap, breakpoint, support, temporal, episode or classification definition change after any 0048 numerical output is observed is forbidden under this research ID. A valid result closes 0048 to same-ID rerun, retuning and rescue regardless of PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE classification.
success_criteria: G0 causal/governance integrity passes: exact frozen data identity, causal features, 56-day label maturity, prequential calibration, one candidate, no post-output retuning, no portfolio economics, and exact ETH/SOL exchange-symmetry invariants.

G1 support passes: at least 12 complete 56-observation formal-evaluation blocks; realized ETH leadership appears in at least 3 distinct full blocks and realized SOL leadership appears in at least 3 distinct full blocks; calibration is identifiable.

G2 incremental predictive information passes: for every frozen causal probabilistic baseline, the simultaneous one-sided 95% moving-block-bootstrap upper confidence bound for candidate-minus-baseline mean NLL is strictly below zero.
G3 discrimination passes: block-bootstrap lower 95% AUC bound is strictly above 0.5 and full-sample balanced accuracy is strictly above 0.5.
G4 proper-score corroboration passes: candidate Brier score is strictly lower than every frozen causal probabilistic baseline Brier score.
G5 temporal robustness passes: candidate NLL is lower than the best causal baseline in at least 3 of 4 mechanically equal-count contiguous evaluation blocks.
G6 causal-episode robustness passes: median episode candidate-minus-best-baseline NLL is below zero and more than half of eligible causal episodes have negative NLL differential.
If G0-G6 pass, classify at least PASS_LEADERSHIP_INFORMATION_NO_CONCENTRATION_HANDOFF even if confidence-handoff gates fail.
For full concentration-handoff eligibility, G7 passes: 56-observation block-bootstrap lower 95% confidence bound of Spearman(confidence, direction-corrected realized margin) is above zero.

For full concentration-handoff eligibility, G8 passes: using bootstrap-reestimated admissible breakpoints, lower 95% confidence bound of HIGH-region mean direction-corrected realized margin is above zero.

For full concentration-handoff eligibility, G9 passes: one admissible segmented breakpoint exists in [0.20,0.80], at least 90% of bootstrap replicates yield an admissible breakpoint, its 95% CI width is at most 0.20, and delta>0 in at least 95% of bootstrap replicates.
For full concentration-handoff eligibility, G10 passes: HIGH coverage is at least 10% of formal evaluation observations and spans at least 6 distinct full 56-observation blocks.
For full two-direction router eligibility, G11 passes: SOL-HIGH occurs in at least 2 eligible causal SOL episodes and ETH-HIGH occurs in at least 2 eligible causal ETH episodes.
Canonical BRRK, Phase 6, leverage, signing, order submission and production authorization remain unchanged.
failure_criteria: Any G0 integrity violation produces INVALID_EXECUTION; the output cannot be treated as the one valid scientific result.
Insufficient support under G1 produces MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT; unidentified primary calibration produces MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE_CALIBRATION_UNIDENTIFIABLE.
If G2, G3 or G4 fails with sufficient valid support, classify FAIL_NO_INCREMENTAL_DYNAMIC_LEADERSHIP.
If G2-G4 pass but G5 or G6 fails, classify FAIL_NO_ROBUST_DYNAMIC_LEADERSHIP while preserving any positive aggregate predictive evidence as partial evidence.
If G2-G6 pass but any of G7-G10 fails, classify PASS_LEADERSHIP_INFORMATION_NO_CONCENTRATION_HANDOFF.
If G2-G10 pass but G11 fails because only one direction has recurrent HIGH support, classify PASS_ONE_SIDED_LEADERSHIP_NO_FULL_ROUTER.
Primary moving-block-bootstrap PASS with materially contradictory frozen subsampling sign diagnostic is reported as INFERENCE_FRAGILE and cannot be hidden or used for rescue.

Any same-ID feature addition, horizon change, calibration replacement, rolling-window rescue, ridge/refit search, baseline replacement, threshold search, alternative episode taxonomy, portfolio allocation test or post-result rerun invalidates that later attempt rather than becoming a second 0048 result.
allowed_followup: Only PASS_LEADERSHIP_INFORMATION_CONCENTRATION_HANDOFF_ELIGIBLE may make a separately preregistered 0049 confidence-driven Beta winner concentration study eligible.

PASS_LEADERSHIP_INFORMATION_NO_CONCENTRATION_HANDOFF may be retained as mechanism evidence but does not authorize probability-driven 80-100% concentration; any alternative confidence translation requires a new research ID.
PASS_ONE_SIDED_LEADERSHIP_NO_FULL_ROUTER may motivate a new one-sided mechanism study but cannot be relabeled as a symmetric ETH/SOL router.
A later 0050 research ID may study Beta-to-BTC continuation value using separately frozen broader risk information; 0048 outputs may be consumed immutably without refitting.
Future genuinely unseen data may be used only under a separately registered future-only validation protocol.
forbidden_followup: No same-ID target-horizon sweep, target weighting change or endpoint-return replacement.

No same-ID feature pruning, feature addition, FAST/SLOW restoration, extra acceleration, BTC Dominance, CORE4, dispersion, funding, OI, macro, sentiment, HMM, tree, boosting or neural-network candidate.
No same-ID ridge-lambda search, training-window search, refit-frequency search or alternate primary probability calibration.
No same-ID manually selected HIGH probability threshold and no use of argmax second derivative as threshold authority.
No same-ID alternate spline knots, second breakpoint, alternate bootstrap block length, alternate temporal partition or alternate causal episode definition after result exposure.
No same-ID portfolio weights, 60/80/90/100 concentration, CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, MDD, Beta-to-BTC or BTC-to-cash economics.
No universe expansion to BNB, UNI, AAVE or other assets.
No canonical BRRK modification, Phase 6 modification, leverage, shorting, signing, order submission or production authorization.
researcher_decisions: Architecture authority is the original 0048 freeze plus the merged amendment at main SHA 09a676e0e704a360730b1df0a57e6010b5a15f00; the amendment supersedes BTC/ETH/SOL symmetric leadership and freezes BTC as defensive anchor with ETH/SOL as the 0048 Beta-selection universe.

0048 formal market-state eligibility is canonical BTC_TREND_FAST>=0 using the existing 20/60/120/240 tanh-scaled trend family and FAST weights 0.15/0.25/0.30/0.30. This is an eligibility filter only, not a BTC-leading episode clock.

The development data reuse the already exposed 0047 BTC/ETH/SOL Binance UTC daily market evidence. The immutable source identity is 0047 market payload SHA256 d1cd28bc76f2cd8ee0486287fc50b49e5451355a3e75132a2de5b30c15af3193 with common history 2020-08-11 through 2026-08-02. 0048 makes no independent-OOS claim.

The formal target uses h in {14,28,56}. A_i,h(t)=2/[h(h+1)] times sum from u=1..h of log(P_i[t+u]/P_i[t]); L_i is the equal one-third mean across the three horizons; M=L_SOL-L_ETH; Y=1 when M>0 and 0 when M<0; exact M=0 is TARGET_TIE and excluded from supervised scoring but counted.

Relative log-price z=log(SOL/ETH), daily relative log return d_t=z_t-z_{t-1}, and trailing relative volatility sigma240 is sample standard deviation ddof=1 over the most recent 240 d observations including t; epsilon is exactly 1e-12 where denominator protection is required.

The four primary momentum features are non-overlapping age buckets using d observations ending at t: K1=t-19..t length20, K2=t-59..t-20 length40, K3=t-119..t-60 length60, K4=t-239..t-120 length120. Each K=tanh(sum(d)/((sigma240+1e-12)*sqrt(block_length))); no cumulative FAST/SLOW or separate acceleration feature is added.
Persistence60 is the arithmetic mean of sign(d) over t-59..t. Exact zero relative returns contribute zero so asset exchange remains antisymmetric.
Position120 is 2*(z_t-min(z_t..z_t-119))/(max-min)-1 with exact zero range mapped to 0. This symmetric relative-position feature replaces the earlier non-antisymmetric relative-drawdown idea.

Participation uses Binance quote_volume only: Activity_i=log((median20_quote_volume_i+1e-12)/(median120_quote_volume_i+1e-12)); Participation=tanh(Activity_SOL-Activity_ETH). It is called relative participation, not capital flow or order flow.
The sole candidate feature vector is exactly [K1,K2,K3,K4,Persistence60,Position120,Participation], each naturally bounded in [-1,1]; no data-dependent z-score standardization is used.

At each refit, expanding Laplace-smoothed matured-label prevalence pi=(N_SOL+1)/(N_SOL+N_ETH+2) is a fixed causal prior. Candidate raw probability is sigmoid(logit(pi)+beta'X) with no fitted intercept. Ridge lambda is fixed at 1 and no hyperparameter search is allowed.
ETH/SOL exchange must map X to -X and pi to 1-pi, and therefore predicted probabilities must sum to one under asset-label exchange within numerical tolerance fixed by implementation tests.

A historical origin s can enter training at prediction origin t only when s+56 calendar days<=t and s was 0048-eligible. Training is expanding. The first shadow prediction requires at least 365 eligible feature-valid fully matured training origins.
Model refits occur every 28 calendar days from the first valid refit anchor. Between refits beta and the prevalence offset are frozen; predictions may be emitted only on eligible origins.

Calibration is shadow-prequential. A raw prediction is stored before its outcome exists and may enter the calibration pool only after its full 56-day label matures. Formal calibrated evaluation begins only after at least 365 matured eligible shadow prediction/outcome pairs exist.

Primary calibration preserves the prevalence prior: p_cal=sigmoid(logit(pi)+gamma*eta), eta=beta'X, gamma>=0 selected by calibration-pool NLL. If no finite stable minimizer exists, calibration is unidentified. Beta calibration and isotonic regression are diagnostics only with zero replacement or rescue authority.
For numerical NLL scoring only, probabilities are clipped to [1e-12,1-1e-12] after model/calibration computation; clipping has no effect on winner direction or confidence state.

B0 is uniform p=0.5. B1 is expanding Laplace prevalence pi. B2 is a one-feature lagged-leader model using H=sign(PastL_SOL-PastL_ETH), where PastA_i,h=2/[h(h+1)]*sum_{u=1..h}log(P_i[t]/P_i[t-u]) for h={14,28,56} and PastL is their equal-third mean. B3 is one-feature 60-day relative momentum RM60=tanh((z_t-z_t-60)/((sigma240+1e-12)*sqrt(60))).

B2 and B3 use the same expanding training, fixed ridge lambda=1, prevalence offset, 28-day refit and shadow-prequential prior-preserving calibration protocol as the candidate. AlwaysHistoricalFavorite is classification diagnostic only.

The simultaneous NLL gate computes d_b,t=loss_candidate-loss_baseline_b. For each 56-observation moving-block bootstrap replicate, aligned evaluation rows are resampled without retraining the walk-forward models. Let T*=max_b(mean(d_b*)-mean(d_b)); q95 is its 95th percentile. Simultaneous UCL_b=mean(d_b)+q95 and G2 requires max_b UCL_b<0.

Primary moving-block bootstrap uses block length 56 ordered eligible formal-evaluation observations, 10000 replicates and seed 4292549012. All candidate/baseline rows share identical sampled block indices. The final overrun is truncated to N.
Confidence is c=2*abs(p_cal-0.5). Direction-corrected realized margin is Z=sign(p_cal-0.5)*M. The confidence-strength curve is G(c)=E[Z|c].

G(c) shape diagnostic uses a natural cubic regression spline with boundary knots 0 and 1 and internal knots 0.25,0.50,0.75. No monotonic constraint or smoothing search is allowed. G' and G'' are diagnostics; argmax G'' has no threshold-selection authority.

The sole HIGH breakpoint model is G(c)=alpha+beta*c+delta*(c-kappa)_+ with exactly one breakpoint. Kappa is the deterministic global SSE minimizer over admissible kappa in [0.20,0.80], ties broken toward the smaller kappa. Each side must contain at least 10% of evaluation observations and at least 4 distinct full 56-observation blocks.

Each bootstrap replicate re-fits the spline and segmented breakpoint on its resampled evaluation rows. Reliable breakpoint requires at least 90% admissible bootstrap breakpoints, percentile 95% kappa CI width<=0.20, and delta>0 in at least 95% of valid breakpoint replicates.

G7 uses percentile 95% moving-block-bootstrap CI for Spearman(c,Z). G8 uses the bootstrap replicate's own admissible kappa to define its HIGH sample and forms the percentile 95% CI of HIGH mean Z, so breakpoint uncertainty is included.

Formal evaluation support requires at least 12 complete sequential 56-observation blocks. A trailing partial block enters aggregate metrics but not the support count. Each realized direction must appear in at least 3 distinct full blocks.

Formal evaluation is mechanically split into four contiguous equal-count temporal blocks with sizes differing by at most one. G5 requires candidate NLL below the minimum baseline NLL in at least 3 of 4 blocks.

Causal episodes are maximal contiguous eligible runs of the sign of Rrel60=log[(SOL_t/SOL_t-60)/(ETH_t/ETH_t-60)]. Exact zero inherits the prior nonzero state; an ineligible day terminates the episode. Only episodes of duration at least 14 calendar observations enter G6 equal-episode robustness.
G6 requires both median episode candidate-minus-best-baseline NLL<0 and strictly more than half eligible episodes with negative differential.

HIGH is c>=kappa only after G9 identifies a reliable breakpoint. If no reliable breakpoint exists, no daily HIGH state is authorized and concentration handoff fails while leadership prediction evidence may still pass.

G10 requires HIGH coverage>=10% and HIGH observations in at least 6 distinct full 56-observation blocks. G11 requires SOL-HIGH in at least 2 eligible causal SOL episodes and ETH-HIGH in at least 2 eligible causal ETH episodes.

Subsampling is a nonselection sign-robustness diagnostic only. Block length b=max(56,ceil(N^(2/3))); all contiguous overlapping subsamples are used; each subsample computes Dmax=max_b mean(d_b). If primary G2 passes but at least half of subsamples have Dmax>=0, report INFERENCE_FRAGILE. This diagnostic has no rescue authority.
All historical 0048 evidence is researcher-exposed DEVELOPMENT. No PASS creates independent OOS evidence, portfolio-economics proof, canonical changes or production authority.

It cannot change BRRK, Phase 6, portfolio weights, Beta-to-BTC or BTC-to-cash rules, or confer production authority.
